summary: Practise relay testing, coordination reviews and fault diagnosis with IEC and IEEE references. Explore the course outline and enrol.
lede: Electrical protection relay testing and coordination involve checking relay response and how settings support selective operation in power systems. The course is for protection engineers, relay technicians and electrical maintenance specialists who need to assess performance, investigate faults and document findings. It develops practical skills in planning secondary-injection tests, reviewing time-current curves and checking trip paths against relay and fault records.
audienceIntro: This course suits electrical professionals who work directly with protection settings, relay testing, fault response or maintenance planning in power systems. It is designed for roles that need to make or review relay-related decisions and document the resulting work.
prerequisites: Prior experience with electrical power systems, protection equipment or electrical maintenance is expected. Familiarity with one-line diagrams and basic AC circuit concepts will help you apply the testing and coordination exercises. No programming is required.
